cpu.description: Average CPU usage of the next run, not its peak

memory.description: Peak memory of the next run, in GB

evaluation_scope: One-time final test: each test run's recommendation is compared with the next run of the same workload.
caveats: CPU is the average usage of a run, not its peak: a run can stay within a CPU recommendation on average and still exceed it during short bursts.
Memory is the peak of a run and is the primary resource.
Only completed runs with full measurements are included.
Results replay the historical test period once: each recommendation is compared with what the next run of the same workload actually used. They are not measurements from a live cluster.
